name: tidelog
description: TideLog — AI-guided daily planning, review, and insight system for Markdown notes

scripts.test: node test-bug-repro.mjs && node test-evening-sop.mjs && node test-save-load.mjs && node test-settings-ui.mjs && node test-onboarding-flow.mjs && node test-commercial-flow.mjs && node test-plan-suggestions.mjs && node test-md-documents.mjs && node test-ai-provider-streaming.mjs && node test-periodic-actions.mjs && node test-first-insight.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.deploy: cp main.js styles.css manifest.json "${OBSIDIAN_VAULT:?Set OBSIDIAN_VAULT to your vault path}/.obsidian/plugins/tidelog/" && echo '✅ Deployed to vault'
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:api && npm run lint:obsidian && npm test && npm run build && npm run release:check
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
